videos.title: How to read your SA power bill
videos.hook: The five numbers on your bill that decide what solar you actually need.
videos.treatment: Caleb at a kitchen table, real bill in hand, red pen circling five numbers, plain English under 60 seconds. Cuts to close-ups of the bill.
videos.location: Client kitchen post-install. Doubles as social proof.

videos.title: GoodWe ESA vs Sigenergy + Gateway
videos.hook: Both brands say whole-home backup. Only one is telling the whole truth.
videos.treatment: Caleb between two installed systems, pointing to each, explaining the motor derate difference. Ends with the $999 Gateway line item on a quote.
videos.location: Workshop wall at 3 Rankine with cutaway boards mounted.

videos.title: 78 turbines at Goyder South
videos.treatment: Drone footage from wind farm work with Caleb voiceover: twelve years ago I terminated the first joint on this ridge. Seventy-eight turbines later, I still do every one myself. Cuts to hands terminating a residential joint today.
videos.location: Drone footage plus close-ups at a current job.

videos.title: The Nyrstar fire response
videos.hook: When cables catch fire, you're on the panel or you're not.
videos.treatment: Slow pan across the HV switch room aftermath (with permission) while Caleb explains the 24-hour mobilisation, 4-night rebuild, zero incidents. Utility and commercial audience play.
videos.location: Nyrstar site with sign-off, or reconstruction shots at 3 Rankine.

videos.title: One day on the tools
videos.treatment: 60-second cut of a full install day. Panels arriving on the ute, racking up, inverter mounting, client signing off, sunset over the completed system.
videos.location: Any live install with client consent.
